name: Margaret 'Maggie' O'Malley
psychographics: Treats her kitchen like a studio; loves experimenting with molecular gastronomy kits but hates when a software update breaks her ingredient-tracking spreadsheet
current_solutions: Joule Sous Vide immersion circulator connected to Yummly; Smart fridge with internal camera; Apple HomeKit for all lighting
frustration: At 11:00 AM last Saturday, a Yummly app update reset her saved temperature presets, erasing 3 weeks of tracked experiments and forcing her to restart her steak doneness log from scratch
decision_style: subscribes to cooking tech newsletters; will pay premium for seamless integration, but abandons a product if the onboarding takes longer than 15 minutes
voice: formal and articulate, peppered with cooking jargon like 'emulsification' and 'sous', yet slips into playful slang when describing a failed recipe
